blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Injecting new subjects naturally during streaming video generation requires integrating newly supplied visual references into the existing video while preserving established subjects and the scene. Encoding references independently of the current scene provides little guidance for this integration, while keeping their features in persistent memory can interfere with established context. We propose ReferStream, a framework that requires no additional training and combines reference construction using the current scene with transient cache injection. Joint Latent places reference latents in target regions of the latest scene latent, allowing reference features to be extracted in context. Cache Restoration uses these features to condition the injection chunk, then restores the overwritten global cache entries while retaining the newly generated history. This procedure incorporates new visual conditions without retraining the generator or revising emitted frames. We further introduce ReferStream Bench, a new benchmark with scheduled reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and explicit annotations of subject presence for InShot and MultiShot generation. Evaluation follows the event schedule and measures both the fidelity of new subjects and the preservation of established subjects, alongside video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy. Experiments on ReferStream Bench show higher scores for text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, including offline methods given all references in advance. Project page: https://xushuolin.github.io/ReferStream/.
blocks.zh: 在流媒体视频生成过程中自然地注入新题材,需要将新提供的视觉参考内容纳入到现有的视频中,同时保留既定主题和场景. 独立于当前场景的编码引用为这种整合提供了很少的指导,同时将其特征保留在持续的内存中可以干扰已确立的上下文. 我们提出ReferenceStream,这个框架不需要额外的培训,并且利用目前的场景将参考建筑与瞬间缓存注射结合起来. 联合梯队在最新场景的目标区域放置了参考潜伏物,从而能够根据具体情况提取参考地物。 缓存还原使用这些特性对注入块进行条件化,然后在保留新生成的历史的同时恢复覆盖的全球缓存条目. 这一程序包含新的视觉条件,而不对发电机进行再培训或修订排放的帧。 我们还引入了ReferenceStream Teach,这是一个新的基准,包括预定的参考抵达、不断演变的指示,以及对InShot和MultiShot一代的主题存在的明确说明。 评价遵循活动时间表,衡量新科目的忠诚程度和既定科目的保存情况,以及视频质量、文本的坚持性和计数准确性。 在参考结构上进行的实验显示,文本的坚持性、主题相似性以及计数精确度都高于比较基线,包括事先提供所有参考的离线方法。 项目网页:https://xushuolin.github.io/ReferStream/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Injecting new subjects into a video during streaming generation requires integrating newly supplied visual references into a scene that has already been established. A user may provide a photograph of a cat after watching a lobby scene containing an umbrella, then ask the cat to enter from the right (Figure 1 ). The reference specifies the cat’s appearance, but its introduction must also fit the ongoing scene and retain the umbrella. With further interactions, multiple references may arrive at different times. Each update must guide subsequent generation while leaving the video the user has already seen unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在流媒体生成过程中将新题材注入视频,需要将新提供的视觉参考纳入已经建立的场景. 用户可能在观看了包含雨伞的大厅场景后提供猫的照片,然后要求猫从右边进入(图1). 参考文献中指定了猫的外观,但其引入也必须符合正在进行的场景并保留伞形. 通过进一步的相互作用,多个参考文献可能会在不同的时间到达. 每次更新都必须指导下一代,同时离开用户已经看到过的视频。

blocks.en: Autoregressive video diffusion provides a basis for this interaction by generating successive chunks conditioned on cached history [ 33 , 11 ] . LongLive and LongLive2 support changing text instructions during generation [ 29 , 5 ] , and Anchor Forcing improves memory continuity across prompt changes [ 30 ] . Visual reference methods such as Phantom, VACE, and HOMIE provide control over subject appearance [ 21 , 15 , 1 ] ; AlcheMinT further specifies temporal intervals for reference subjects [ 8 ] . We study interactive subject injection, where new visual references become available during causal generation. The arrival of a reference determines when its appearance information becomes accessible, in addition to when the subject should appear. This setting requires adapting an existing scene to information supplied after generation has begun.
blocks.zh: 自动递归视频传播为这种交互提供了基础,通过生成以缓存历史为条件的连续块[33,11]. LongLive和LongLive2支持在生成过程中修改文本指令[29,5],Anchor Forcing则通过即时修改改善内存连续性[30]. 视觉参考方法如Phantom,VACE,和HOMIE提供对对象外观的控制[21,15,1];AlcheMinT进一步规定了参考对象的时间间隔[8]. 我们研究交互主题注入,在因果生成时,可以提供新的视觉参考。 参考物的到来决定其外观信息何时可以调取,以及主体何时应当出现. 这种设置要求对现有场景进行修改,使其适应生成后提供的信息。

blocks.en: Two difficulties arise when incorporating these references into a streaming generator. First, a reference depicts its subject at a scale, viewpoint, and background that may differ from the generated scene. Encoding it independently supplies appearance information without explicitly relating it to the surrounding content. Second, the generator’s cache already represents established subjects and the scene. Replacing persistent entries with reference features can help introduce a subject, but leaving those features in place may continue to favor the reference composition after the subject has entered. Reference construction and the duration of its influence therefore need to be considered together.
blocks.zh: 在将这些参考纳入流体生成器时会出现两个困难。 首先,一个参考文献以可能与生成的场景不同的尺度,视角和背景来描述其主题. 独立编码它提供外观信息,而没有明确将其与周围内容联系起来. 其次,生成器的缓存已经代表了既定对象和场景. 替换带有参考特征的持久条目有助于引入一个主题,但保留这些特征可能会在主题输入后继续倾向于参考成分. 因此,参考构建及其影响期限需要一并考虑。

blocks.en: We propose ReferStream, which combines Joint Latent and Cache Restoration on a frozen LongLive2 backbone [ 5 ] . Joint Latent places encoded references within target regions of the latest clean scene latent, allowing reference features to be extracted in context. Cache Restoration temporarily writes these features into selected global cache entries, then restores the original entries after the injection chunk is generated and committed. The newly generated history remains available to carry the subject forward, without updating model parameters or revising emitted frames.
blocks.zh: 我们提出ReferenceStream,它结合了联合Latent和Cache恢复在冷冻的LongLive2骨干上[5]. 联合Latent将最新的清洁场景潜伏的目标区域内的编码参考文献放在一起,从而可以在上下文中提取参考文献。 缓存还原将这些特性临时写入选定的全局缓存条目,然后在注入块生成并被承诺后恢复原始条目. 新产生的历史仍然可供继续讨论,而不更新模型参数或修订排放的框架。

blocks.en: Assessing this task requires accounting for reference arrival and the persistence of established subjects. OpenS2V-Nexus evaluates reference consistency, naturalness, and text relevance [ 34 ] . We introduce ReferStream Bench with scheduled reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and expected subject presence. InShot introduces subjects within a continuous shot, while MultiShot permits declared transitions. Evaluation measures new and established subjects alongside video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy.
blocks.zh: 要评估这项任务,就必须对参考文献的到来和既定主题的持久性进行核算。 OpenS2V-Nexus评价参考一致性,自然性和文本相关性[34]. 我们引入了ReferenceStream法官,包括预定的参考到达、不断变化的指示和预期的课题。 InShot在连续镜头中引入主题,而MultiShot允许宣布过渡. 评价除了视频质量、文本遵守度和计数准确性之外,还衡量新的和既定的主题。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We formulate interactive subject injection during causal video generation, where visual references arrive at user chosen times and must be integrated while preserving established subjects and scene content. • We develop ReferStream, combining Joint Latent for reference construction in scene context with Cache Restoration for transient conditioning, without additional training or revision of emitted frames. • We introduce ReferStream Bench for InShot and MultiShot generation, with explicit event schedules and evaluation of new subject fidelity, established subject preservation, video quality, text adherence, and count accuracy. • Experiments show higher text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, including offline methods given all references in advance. Video quality results are mixed. Ablations characterize the tradeoffs between fidelity and preservation, and experiments on OpenS2V [ 34 ] further support Joint Latent.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 我们在因果视频生成过程中进行交互式主题注入,视觉参考资料在用户选定的时间到达,必须加以整合,同时保留既定主题和场景内容。 我们开发了ReferStream,将现场参考建筑联合Latet与缓存修复进行瞬态调节相结合,不增加培训或修改排放框架。 我们推出InShot和MultiShot生成的ReferStream座椅,有明确的活动日程和评估新的主题忠诚度、既定的主题保存、视频质量、文本遵守度和计数准确性。 • 实验显示,文字的坚持度、主题相似性以及精确度高于比较基线,包括事先提供所有参考的离线方法。 视频质量结果喜忧参半. 忠诚与保全之间的权衡与OpenS2V的实验[34]进一步支持联合Latent的特征.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video generation models. Spatiotemporal latent compression and diffusion transformers underpin recent video generators such as CogVideoX, HunyuanVideo, and Wan [ 31 , 17 , 27 ] . LTX-Video emphasizes efficient latent synthesis [ 9 ] , while LTX-2 and MiniMax H3 extend generation to synchronized audiovisual content and multimodal conditioning [ 10 , 23 ] . These advances provide strong synthesis backbones. Our work concerns how a causal generator incorporates visual references that become available after part of the video has already been emitted.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型. Spatiotemporal潜在压缩和传播变压器支撑了最近的视频发电机,如CogVideoX、HunyuanVideo和Wan[31、17、27]。 LTX-Video强调高效的潜伏合成[9],而LTX-2和MiniMax H3则将生成扩展到同步的视听内容和多式联运[10,23]. 这些进步提供了强大的合成骨干. 我们的工作涉及一个因果生成者如何在部分视频已经发布后纳入可视化参考。

blocks.en: Subject-to-video generation. Visual references specify subject identities, with related applications in portrait and human animation [ 14 , 28 ] . Video Alchemist and ConceptMaster study personalization across arbitrary subject categories and the separation of multiple reference concepts [ 4 , 12 ] . Phantom and MAGREF develop reference conditioning mechanisms for consistent synthesis of one or more subjects [ 21 , 6 ] ; VACE unifies reference generation and video editing, while HOMIE focuses on personalization of humans and objects [ 15 , 1 ] . OpenS2V-Nexus provides a detailed benchmark and a large dataset for evaluating and training models conditioned on subject references [ 34 ] . AlcheMinT further conditions references on temporal intervals to control subject appearance and disappearance [ 8 ] . Our setting instead reveals new references during causal generation, requiring their integration into an established scene while preserving subjects that should remain. Reference arrival therefore determines what information the generator can use, in addition to when a subject should appear.
blocks.zh: 主体至影视一代. 视觉参考 指定主题身份,相关应用在肖像和人文动画[14,28]. 视频化学家与概念 主体研究跨任意学科类的个性化和多个参考概念的分离[4,12]. Phantom和MAGREF为一个或多个主题的一致合成建立参考条件机制[21,6];VACE统一了参考生成和视频编辑,而HOMIE则注重人类和物体的个性化[15,1]. OpenS2V-Nexus提供了详细的基准和一个大型数据集,用于以主题参考为条件的评价和培训模型[34]. AlcheMinT进一步规定了关于时间间隔的参考条件,以控制对象的出现和消失[8]. 相反,我们的背景揭示了因果生成时新的参考,要求它们融入既定的舞台,同时保留应当保留的主题。 因此,参考到达除了确定一个主体何时出现之外,还确定生成者可以使用何种信息.

blocks.en: Streaming generation and interactive editing. Diffusion Forcing and SkyReels-V2 use heterogeneous temporal noise levels for sequence generation and long video synthesis [ 2 , 3 ] . CausVid distills a causal video generator, while Self Forcing trains on context generated by the model itself to reduce exposure bias [ 33 , 11 ] . Other work addresses historical context and memory efficiency [ 35 , 32 , 37 ] , as well as stability in interactive world exploration [ 19 ] . CausVid also supports streaming video-to-video translation; StreamDiffusion and StreamDiffusionV2 optimize interactive pipelines for low latency [ 33 , 16 , 7 ] . LongLive supports prompt changes through cache updates, and LongLive2 extends interactive generation to videos with multiple shots with efficient parallel training and inference [ 29 , 5 ] . Anchor Forcing improves continuity across prompt changes by using anchors to guide recaching and realigning positional embeddings [ 30 ] . Building on this streaming formulation, we study how newly supplied visual references enter the cache and how the original global memory is restored after injection, without revising emitted frames.
blocks.zh: 流传生成与互动编辑. 扩散强化和SkyReels-V2使用不同时间噪声水平进行序列生成和长视频合成[2,3]. 原因 Vid蒸馏一个因果视频生成器,而Self Forcing列车在模型本身产生的上下文上,以减少曝光偏差[33,11]. 其他工作涉及历史背景和记忆效率[35,32,37],以及互动世界探索中的稳定性[19]. 原因 Vid还支持流线视频对视频的翻译; StreamDifumation和 StreamDifumation V2 优化互动管线,用于低延迟[33, 16, 7]. LongLive支持通过缓存更新进行即时更改,LongLive2将交互式生成扩展至具有多个镜头的视频,同时进行高效的并行训练和推断[29,5]. Anchor Forcing通过使用锚点来引导重新定位和重新调整位置嵌入[30],提高了快速变化的连续性. 基于这种流式配方,我们研究新提供的视觉参考如何输入缓存,以及如何在注入后恢复原全球内存,而不修订已发射帧.

blocks.en: 3.5 ReferStream Bench for interactive subject injection
blocks.zh: 3.5 互动主题注入参考结构

blocks.en: Conventional generation conditioned on references starts with its visual conditions already available. Interactive subject injection instead requires a generator to incorporate new appearance information after committing to a scene. Evaluating only whether a reference identity appears somewhere in the video misses a central requirement: it must appear at the requested stage while established subjects remain when the script requires them. ReferStream Bench therefore organizes each sequence around reference arrivals, evolving instructions, and expected subject presence.
blocks.zh: 常规生成以参考材料为条件,从已有的视觉条件开始。 交互主题注入需要生成器在承诺到场景后输入新的外观信息. 仅仅评价视频中是否有某个地方出现参考身份,没有考虑一个中心要求:必须在要求的阶段出现,而在剧本需要时,确定的主题仍然保留。 因此,参考法官围绕参考抵达者、不断演变的指令和预期的课题安排每个序列。

blocks.en: Each entry pairs references with a chronological script specifying reveal boundaries, stage captions, normalized target regions where provided, and explicit cut flags. The frozen collection contains 48 InShot entries and 20 MultiShot entries. InShot requires introduction within a continuous shot; MultiShot permits a declared transition. The online protocol reveals conditions incrementally, while the offline comparison receives the references and script upfront. These information settings are reported separately. Requested departures are distinguished from unintended identity loss.
blocks.zh: 每个条目的引用对齐,并附有一个时间顺序的脚本,指定显示边界、舞台标题、提供目标区域正常化和明确剪切旗帜。 冻结的藏品包含48个InShot条目和20个MultiShot条目. InShot需要在连续镜头内引入;MultiShot允许宣布的过渡. 在线协议以递增方式揭示条件,而离线比较则获得参考文献和脚本前置. 这些信息设置单独报告. 要求的离境不同于意外丧失身份。

Approximate durations of 10, 15, 20, and 60 seconds occur in 39, 20, 3, and 6 entries, respectively, covering both short introductions and longer interactions after injection. blocks.en: Evaluation follows the event schedule: New-ID measures introduced subjects while present, Existing-ID measures established subjects that should persist, and Count checks the expected counts in each target category. Quality over the full video and matching against the active caption complement these subject measures. Allowed cuts and requested departures determine which observations are applicable. ReferStream Bench is a curated task resource rather than an exhaustive interaction taxonomy or an independently sampled held-out test set. Counting conventions and exclusions due to inconsistent reference assets are documented in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 评价按照活动时间表进行:新ID措施在出现时引入了主题,现有ID措施设定了应该坚持下去的主题,以及计数检查每个目标类别的预期数。 整个视频的质量与主动字幕的匹配补充了这些主题措施。 允许的削减和要求的离开决定哪些意见适用。 参考结构 座椅是包罗万象的任务资源,而不是详尽无遗的交互分类或独立抽样的搁置测试。 附录A.2记录了由于参考资产不一致而导致的计算惯例和不适用情形。

blocks.en: 4.1 Benchmark and comparison protocols
blocks.zh: 4.1 基准和比较协议

blocks.en: We evaluate on ReferStream Bench (Section 3.5 ) under InShot and MultiShot settings. All methods use the same frozen specifications and event schedules defined in physical time within their respective information settings. Entries with inconsistent reference assets are excluded uniformly across methods; the exclusions and temporal alignment rules are documented in Appendix A .

blocks.en: We compare ReferStream with LongLive 2.0 [ 5 ] under the same event schedule. The baseline receives stage captions and declared cuts but no reference images, including at initialization. ReferStream receives visual references at their scheduled reveals. The main comparison uses previously generated ReferStream outputs, aligned to the benchmark timeline as detailed in Appendix A.3 . These comparisons evaluate the complete systems; paired ablations in Section 4.4 examine the contributions of individual components.

Runs use seed 0, 50 sampling steps, and 832 × 480 832\times 480 output. blocks.en: Thin rules separate online methods (LongLive and ReferStream) from offline methods given all references (VACE, Phantom, and HOMIE). Offline methods have advance access to future references, so their scores describe adherence to the supplied script rather than adaptation to newly available information.
blocks.zh: 瘦规则将在线方法(LongLive和ReferenceStream)与离线方法(VACE、Phantom和HOMIE)区分开来。 离线方法可以提前获得未来的引用,因此它们的分数描述了对所提供脚本的遵守,而不是适应新获得的信息.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要评价尺度

blocks.en: We report six complementary metrics without combining them into a weighted overall score. Aesthetic quality follows VBench [ 13 ] , using CLIP ViT-L/14 [ 25 ] and the LAION linear aesthetic head [ 18 ] . Motion smoothness uses AMT-S [ 20 ] frame reconstruction, excluding triplets crossing declared cuts; a high score alone does not establish rich motion. GME-T uses GME’s multimodal embedding model [ 36 ] , following the approach to matching frames and text in OpenS2V-Nexus [ 34 ] , to compare each frame with its active stage caption. These columns summarize quality over the full video and text adherence. GME-T is not a direct test of each requested spatial relation or action.
blocks.zh: 我们报告6个补充衡量标准,但没有将它们合并为加权总分。 美学质量跟随V Bench [13],使用CLIP VIT-L/14 [25]和LAION线性美学头[18]. 运动平滑性采用AMT-S [20] 帧重建,不包括三胞胎通过宣布的切片;单靠高分并不能建立丰富的运动. GME-T采用GME的多模式嵌入模式[36],遵循OpenS2V-Nexus [34]中的帧和文本匹配方法,将每个帧与其活跃的阶段标题进行比较. 这些栏目概括了整个视频和文本遵守的质量。 GME-T并不是对每个请求的空间关系或动作的直接测试.

blocks.en: New-ID measures reference similarity of the newly introduced subject after reveal, while it is expected to be present, pooling early and later observations into one score. Existing-ID measures subjects established before the event that should remain afterward. Grounding DINO detections [ 22 ] , SAM 2.1 masks for each frame [ 26 ] , and DINOv2-L features [ 24 ] provide one-to-one matching restricted to the same category; missing subjects score zero. Count accuracy requires exact agreement with the expected count in every target category. Categories outside the specified targets are ignored, and stages during which subjects depart are excluded from counting. Subject metrics average observations within events, events within cases, and cases with equal weight. All reported scores are multiplied by 100; ID columns remain similarity scores, not recognition percentages. Appendix A specifies checkpoints and preprocessing.

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes performance across ReferStream Bench, while Table 2 separates InShot and MultiShot. The overall scores use equal case weight rather than an unweighted average of the two setting means; each metric uses its eligible observations under the same rules for expected subject presence. ReferStream obtains the highest GME-T (62.41), New-ID (52.86), Existing-ID (73.18), and Count accuracy (82.33) among the compared methods. Relative to LongLive without visual references, the New-ID and Existing-ID gains are 12.87 and 30.89 score points, respectively, and Count accuracy increases by 8.43 percentage points. The stronger preservation gain is particularly relevant to interactive generation, where adding a new subject should retain established subjects that remain in the script.

These dimensions are reported separately because a high smoothness score based on interpolation does not by itself establish identity fidelity or adherence to the changing instruction.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ReferStream for injecting newly supplied visual references into a video during causal streaming generation. Joint Latent constructs reference features in the current scene, while Cache Restoration limits their direct influence to the injection chunk and retains the generated history. Together, they allow a frozen generator to incorporate new subjects without revising emitted frames. ReferStream Bench evaluates this interaction through reference arrival schedules and explicit expectations for new and established subjects. Across InShot and MultiShot, ReferStream achieves higher measured text adherence, subject similarity, and count accuracy than the compared baselines, with mixed results for video quality. The ablations show that preserving established content can come at a cost in similarity to the new reference. These findings support considering both the scene context used to construct reference features and the duration of their influence in persistent memory. Broader evaluation across seeds and further validation of automatic subject metrics remain useful next steps.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了ReferStream,用于在因果流媒体生成过程中将新提供的视觉参考注入视频. 联合Latet构造当前场景中的参考特征,而Cache Reform则将其直接影响限制在注入块上,并保留生成的历史. 它们共同允许一个冷冻发电机在不修订排放框架的情况下纳入新的主题。 参考结构法官通过参考抵达时间表和对新的既定科目的明确期望来评价这种互动。 纵观InShot和MultiShot,ReferenceStream实现了比比较基线更高的测量文本坚持度,主题相似,计数精确度,视频质量效果好坏参半. 详细情况表明,保留既定内容的代价可能与新的参考资料相似。 这些调查结果支持既考虑到用于构建参考特征的场景背景,也考虑到其在持续记忆中的影响时间。 更广泛的种子评价和进一步验证自动标的,仍然是今后的有益步骤。

blocks.en: A.1 Reference construction and cache updates
blocks.zh: A.1 参考构建和缓存更新

blocks.en: The reference branch uses the frozen Wan VAE and LongLive2 DiT. The exported configuration generates eight latent frames per chunk, uses eight global sink frames and four sampling steps, and configures the local attention window for 32 latent frames. Reference K/V is stored without quantization. The backbone’s quantization and parallelization options are separate from this cache intervention.
blocks.zh: 参考分支使用冷冻的Wan VAE和LongLive2 DiT. 输出配置每块产生8个潜在框架,使用8个全球汇框架和4个采样步骤,并为32个潜在框架配置局部关注窗口. 参考 K/V 不进行定量存储。 骨干化和平行化选项与这种缓存干预是分开的.

blocks.en: For a normalized target box, Joint Latent insets each side by δ = 0.05 \delta=0.05 , clips the coordinates to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , and rejects collapsed boxes. The endpoints are scaled to latent resolution, rounded, and clamped to a nonempty grid rectangle. The full reference encoding is bilinearly resized to this rectangle with align_corners=False ; explicit boxes override layout defaults. The latest clean scene latent is repeated across reference slots, and the full configuration uses unit reference strength. With no generated history, the canvas is zero. Multiple rectangles are written in reference order. Without Joint Latent, full reference latents occupy temporal slots, with separate blocks allocated to multiple references.
blocks.zh: 对于一个正态的目标框,联合Latent以 = 0.05\ delta= 0.05 的方式将两边的坐标剪到 [0, 1] [0, 1],并拒绝倒塌的框. 端点缩放为潜在分辨率,四舍五入,并夹入非空格矩形. 完整的参考编码是双线调整大小到这个矩形,并配对_corners=False;清晰的框覆盖布局默认. 最新的清洁场景潜伏被跨参考槽重复,全配置使用单位参考强度. 没有生成历史,画布为零. 多个矩形按参考顺序书写. 没有联合基准,充分参考的潜在因素占用时间段,为多种参考分配单独的区块。

blocks.en: A clean reference pass runs in an empty temporary cache with temporal coordinates aligned to the destination global slots, starting at slot zero. Original K/V tensors are cloned before replacement in every transformer layer. Denoising writes temporary current-chunk K/V; the clean pass replaces these writes before Cache Restoration restores the saved global entries. The generated latent, other cache entries, and advanced indices remain. Overlapping temporary writes are restored in reverse order. When classifier-free guidance is enabled, the transaction applies to both conditional and unconditional caches.
blocks.zh: 一个干净的参考证在空临时缓存中运行,时间坐标与目的地全局槽一致,从零档开始. 每个变压器层在更换前先克隆原有的K/V变压器. Denoising写临时的当前chunk K/V;在缓存恢复恢复保存的全球条目之前,干净的通行证取代了这些写入. 产生的潜在、其他缓存条目和高级指数依然存在。 重叠临时写作按照反向顺序恢复. 当启用无分类器引导时,交易既适用于有条件的缓存,也适用于无条件的缓存.

blocks.en: The runtime can also pin a generated chunk as a refreshed shot anchor at a configured delay after the reference event. This policy is determined by the archived configuration and remains part of 𝒰 θ \mathcal{U}_{\theta} ; Equation 5 restores the global entries without requiring the entire shot cache to remain unchanged. Hidden preroll establishes the initial scene in the archived InShot schedules. Later references have their own event intervals. Text updates refresh text conditioning without automatically cutting the shot or discarding its visual history.
blocks.zh: 运行时间也可以将一个生成的块作为更新的射击锚在参考事件后配置的延迟上标注. 此策略由存档配置决定, 并且仍然是 U \\ mathcal{ U\\theta} 的一部分; 方程式 5 恢复全局条目, 而不需要整个射击缓存保持不变 。 隐藏预卷在存档的InShot调度中建立初始场景. 后来的参考文献有自己的活动间隔. 文本更新更新文本条件,而不自动剪辑镜头或丢弃其视觉历史.

blocks.en: A.2 Benchmark curation
blocks.zh: A.2 基准规范

blocks.en: The frozen collection contains 68 entries and 67 base scenario names: the storeroom cat/jar scenario has two archived variants. Reference statistics deduplicate subject paths within each entry, exclude environment-only references, and count reuse across entries. Plants belong to objects; vocabulary labels retain appearance descriptions and do not denote unique identities. Approximate 10/15/20/60 second duration bins contain 39/20/3/6 entries, based on archived video metadata. Behavior labels are counted once per entry, can overlap, and include hopping under ground locomotion. The collection was frozen before baseline evaluation and is a curated development resource.
blocks.zh: 冰冻的藏品包含68个条目和67个基本情景名称:库房猫/贾尔情景有两个存档的变体. 参考统计在每一条目中均对主题路径进行调试,不包括仅限环境参考,并计算各条目的重复使用。 植物属于对象;词汇标签保留外观描述,不表示独特的身份. 大约 10/15/20/60 第二次持续时间的bins包含39/20/3/6条目,基于存档的视频元数据. 行为标签每个条目计算一次,可以重叠,包括跳跃在地面运动下. 收集工作在基线评估前就已冻结,是经过整理的发展资源。

blocks.en: A.3 Output sources and temporal alignment
blocks.zh: A.3 产出来源和时间调整

blocks.en: The evaluator maps decoded source frames to the canonical timeline without pixel interpolation or video recompression. For 24 fps presentation exports with one leading frame removed, the first retained frame supplies the missing canonical position. Legacy 16 fps MultiShot outputs use recorded leading-frame corrections and nominal five-second stages; LongLive maps four chunks to each such stage. For edited 30 fps long videos, endpoint-preserving indices j = round ⁡ ( i ⁡ ( N s − 1 ) / ( N t − 1 ) ) j=\operatorname{round}(i(N_{s}-1)/(N_{t}-1)) map target frames to source frames, where N s N_{s} and N t N_{t} are the source and target frame counts. Where edit positions are unrecorded, this mapping assumes uniform progression through the source clip and does not recover exact local event boundaries.
blocks.zh: 评估者将解码的源帧映射到犬科时间表,没有像素插图或视频重压. 对于24 fps 演示导出并移除一个主框,第一个保留框供应缺失的犬形位置. 遗留的16英尺/秒的多热输出使用记录的前帧校正和标称的五秒级; LongLive 将四个块绘制到每个这样的阶段. 对于经过编辑的30fps长视频,端点保留指数j =  round ⁡(i ⁡ (Ns − 1) / (Nt − 1)) j =\ operatorname{round}(i(N_{s)}-1)/(N_{t)-1) 将目标帧映射到源帧,其中Ns N_{s}和Nt N_{t}为源和目标帧计数. 在未记录编辑位置时,此映射假设通过源剪辑实现统一进度,不会恢复准确的本地事件边界.

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation pipeline and pretrained components
blocks.zh: A.4 评价管道和预先培训的构成部分

blocks.en: RGB frames are resized to 832 × 480 832\times 480 with Lanczos before evaluator preprocessing. All methods use the same evaluators and thresholds. Table 5 lists the components; source URLs, repository revisions where available, and checkpoint hashes are retained in the experiment records.
blocks.zh: RGB帧在评价者预处理前与Lanczos调整为832×480 832\时. 所有方法都使用相同的评价员和阈值。 表5列出了组件;在实验记录中保留了源URL,可能情况下的寄存器修改,以及检查站散列.

blocks.en: Aesthetic and GME-T samples use t = 0.125 + 0.25 ​ n t=0.125+0.25n seconds, taking the nearest native frame with ties resolved forward. Aesthetic quality uses normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 features and the LAION linear predictor, divided by ten. GME-T computes similarity between each frame and its active caption using the 7B GME checkpoint in half precision. Motion evaluation uses 8 fps samples, triplets with a stride of two, and one minus normalized AMT-S reconstruction error; triplets crossing declared cuts are excluded. Each metric is averaged within a video and then across cases with equal weight.
blocks.zh: 美学和GME-T样品使用t=0.125+0.25n t=0.125+0.25n秒,取最接近的带结的原生框架向前. 美学质量采用规范化的CLIP VIT-L/14特征和LAION线性预测器,除以10. GME-T 使用 7B GME 检查点对每个帧及其活动标题进行半精确的类似计算. 运动评价使用8个fps样本,三胞胎的步法为2,一个减常态的AMT-S重建错误;三胞胎通过宣布的切除被排除. 每一度量均在视频中进行平均,然后在同等重的个案中进行平均。

blocks.en: Grounding DINO Tiny queries the target categories jointly, using a rodent alias for groundhog. Detections are scored at threshold 0.50, with within-category NMS at 0.5 IoU and cross-category NMS at 0.7. Candidates from 0.20 are retained for inspection. SAM 2.1 Large selects the highest-confidence mask for each box. Pixels outside the mask are replaced with gray (RGB 127), and the box crop is encoded with DINOv2-L without registers. References receive the same preprocessing. Hungarian matching is restricted to the same category; missing subjects score zero and cosine similarities are clipped to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . ID uses continuous similarities, without an identity threshold. Scheduled departure transitions are excluded from ID and Count. Subject scores average observations within events, events within cases, and then cases equally.
blocks.zh: 地平线 Tiny一并查询目标类别,对土拨鼠使用鼠类别名. 检测结果在0.50分阈值中得分,类别内核聚变为0.5分,跨类别核聚变为0.7分。 保留0.20名候选人以供检查。 SAM 2.1 大项为每个盒子选择最高自信面具. 面具外的像素被灰色(RGB 127)所取代,盒子作物被编码为DINOv2-L,没有注册. 参考文献得到同样的预处理。 匈牙利比对被限制在同一个类别;缺失的科目得分为0,余弦相似被剪切为[0,1] [0,1]. ID使用连续的相似性,没有身份门槛. 计划离开的过渡不包括在身份证和伯爵名单上。 主体对事件内的平均观察,案件内的事件,然后对案件进行平均的评分.

blocks.en: Table 5: Evaluation components and pretrained checkpoints. Linked names point to the checkpoint provider or official implementation.
blocks.zh: 表5:评价构成部分和预先训练的检查站。 链接名称指检查站提供者或正式实施。

blocks.en: The detector was adjusted on a fixed development sample reviewed with model assistance before inspecting aggregate rankings, then kept unchanged across methods. No method-specific thresholds or manual score corrections are used. Audits checked aggregation against stored observations. Chicken/groundhog confusion, missed jars, and partial detections remain possible, so these checks do not replace independent human validation. The event windows, presence rules, and aggregation are task-specific adaptations of the cited evaluators. The reported comparisons do not establish robustness across generation seeds.
blocks.zh: 探测器在经过模型协助审查的固定开发样本上进行了调整,然后检查了综合排名,然后在方法上保持不变。 不采用特定方法的阈值或人工计分校正. 审计对照储存的观察对汇总进行了检查。 鸡/groushog混淆,漏掉的罐子,以及部分检测仍然是可能的,因此这些检查并不能取代独立的人类验证. 活动窗口、存在规则和汇总是上述评价人员针对具体任务的调整。 所报告的比较没有确定不同代种子的稳健性。

blocks.en: B.1 Subset design and interpretation
blocks.zh: B.1 子集的设计和解释

blocks.en: The common comparison uses 48 paired InShot cases at seed 0. The initialization subset contains 39 ten-second cases with a single reference injection at generation start. The multistage subset contains nine cases: three lasting 15 seconds and six lasting 60 seconds. Membership follows the archived schedules, independently of metric outcomes. Multistage denotes successive events within these schedules, rather than the MultiShot setting.
blocks.zh: 常见的比较在0号种子时使用48对的InShot病例. 初始化子集包含39个10秒的病例,在生成时进行单一的参考注射. 多阶段子集包含9个案例:3个持续15秒,6个持续60秒. 成员按存档时间表行事,不考虑衡量结果。 多阶段表示这些时间表内连续的事件,而不是多热设定.

blocks.en: Full denotes ReferStream with both components. The initialization comparison holds the cache policy fixed and changes only Joint Latent (Table 4 ); the multistage comparison changes only Cache Restoration (Table 6 ). Full means differ because the subsets contain different cases. Their absolute values should not be compared with one another or with the separate main experiment archive.
blocks.zh: 完全表示具有两个组件的参考结构。 初始化比较使缓存策略固定下来,只更改联合Latet(表4);多阶段比较只更改缓存恢复(表6)。 完全含义不同,因为子集包含不同的情况. 它们的绝对值不应相互比较或与单独的主实验档案相比较.

blocks.en: New-ID and Existing-ID measure reference similarity, which may reflect category, appearance, and context as well as identity. At initialization, Existing-ID labels the other expected subject; it does not test preservation across a later reference arrival. Duplication measures unwanted copies of each subject and is distinct from the main Count metric, which requires all target counts to match. The single-seed comparisons describe the observed tradeoffs rather than establish statistical significance.
blocks.zh: 新ID和现有ID计量的参考相似性,可以反映类别,外观,上下文以及身份. 在初始化时,现有ID标记了另一个预期对象;它不会在后来的参考到来时测试保存. 重复度量每个科目的不想要的副本,与主计数度量标准不同,它要求所有目标计数匹配. 单一种子的比较说明观察到的权衡,而不是确定统计意义。

blocks.en: B.2 Cache Restoration over successive events
blocks.zh: B.2 连续事件的缓存修复

blocks.en: Table 6 tests whether restoring the original global memory helps retain subjects through later events. Existing-ID rises from 46.44 to 58.60 and Existing Duplication falls from 46.30 to 37.04. New-ID decreases from 53.67 to 47.38, while New Duplication increases from 16.67 to 21.30. This pattern supports a preservation benefit on the multistage subset, together with a cost to the newly introduced subject. It complements the common-set ablation and concerns a different temporal setting from initial reference conditioning.

In the selected baseline frames, LongLive2 shows a different burner shape from the outset; Phantom and HOMIE do not retain the hen in the later views. blocks.zh: C.2 控制多热阶段的组成

blocks.en: Together, the InShot and MultiShot examples illustrate two uses of the same interface: introducing a subject within an ongoing shot and updating composition across a declared cut. Users may submit references at arbitrary times, with each arrival applied at the next chunk boundary. The benchmark fixes these times for reproducible comparisons, while the generator conditions on each reference only after its arrival.
blocks.zh: InShot和MultiShot的例子共同说明了同一界面的两个用途:在进行中的镜头中引入一个主题,在宣布的剪切中更新组成. 用户可在任意的时间提交参考文献,每次到达都应用在下一个块边界。 基准确定这些时间进行可复制的比较,而每个参考的生成者只有在到达后才有条件。
